description: This Java class 'EnforcedThingFlattener' flattens a 'Thing' JSON object with associated enforcement policies into a list of pointer-value documents for indexing and search. It processes JSON features, applies length restrictions, and includes enforcement of permissions and feature ID handling.

classes.name: EnforcedThingFlattener
classes.description: A final class that flattens a JSON representation of a 'Thing' with enforcement policies into indexable documents, handling feature path modifications and permission effects.

methods.name: flattenJson
methods.description: Static method that takes JSON object, enforcer, and max array size to produce a BSON array of flattened documents.

methods.name: nullValue
methods.description: Represents a JSON null value for a given key as a document.

methods.name: bool
methods.description: Represents a boolean JSON value for a given key as a document.

methods.name: string
methods.description: Represents a string JSON value for a given key as a document.

methods.name: number
methods.description: Represents a numeric JSON value for a given key as a document.

methods.name: array
methods.description: Processes a stream of JSON arrays, flattening and limiting size for indexing.

methods.name: object
methods.description: Processes a stream of JSON objects, flattening nested documents.

methods.name: singleton
methods.description: Creates a single document for a given key and JSON value, applies enforcement, and manages feature ID substitutions.

methods.name: computeEffectedSubjectIds
methods.description: Calculates subjects affected by permissions for a given key using the enforcer.

methods.name: toBsonArray
methods.description: Converts an iterable collection of authorization subjects to a BSON array.

methods.name: assembleDocument
methods.description: Builds a BSON document with key, value, grant list, and revoke list.

methods.name: replaceFeatureIdByWildcard
methods.description: Replaces feature IDs with a wildcard for general feature indexing, if applicable.
